boundaries: MAI-01..10 and AAI-01 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-02 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or implementation authority
audio intent, provider identity and provider asset/reference identity remain separate
no provider/catalog is canonical and unsupported/unknown provider capabilities remain explicit

user-owned file possession does not infer public-performance, redistribution or commercial rights

missing or disabled audio never blocks play

migration 0022 remains unreserved until a separately demonstrated durable schema delta requires it
AAI-03+ and provider runtime integration remain unauthorized
no provider acquisition/download/authentication/scraping/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation is authorized by selection
